verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26482757 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318649 (2026-04-15). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each: item 00020 for 9,500 pcs confirmed 2026-05-20, and item 00010 for 8,500 pcs confirmed 2026-05-15. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The terms text contradicts itself, because it adds seller-prepaid freight, insurance and duties to the invoice.
red_flags: Terms contradict each other: EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', yet 'Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice'. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so charges added to the invoice need clarifying.

Same material CMP-GAM-002 appears on two lines (00020: 9,500 and 00010: 8,500) with different confirmed dates (2026-05-20 and 2026-05-15). Total is 18,000 pcs. The lines are listed out of order (00020 before 00010).
The document has no issue date. No unit of measure is stated for the quantities.
observations: Clean printed single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Quantities use comma thousands separators (English convention), read as 9500 and 8500.
The description wraps over three lines in the table; read as 'Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5'.
